summary: The filing discloses a cybersecurity incident, not a special situation. NovoCure Limited filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 on September 1, 2026, reporting unauthorized access to its information systems in mid-August 2026. The incident exposed internal patient ID numbers, some patient data for fewer than 50 patients, and contact information, but did not compromise operations or medical devices. The company does not currently believe the incident will have a material impact, but may amend if new information emerges. This is a routine disclosure, so category is None.
